## Physical scenario

A force \( \vec{F}_1 \) of magnitude 6.00 units acts on an object at the origin in a direction \( \theta = 30.0^\circ \) above the positive \( x \) axis as shown in figure. A second force \( \vec{F}_2 \) of magnitude 5.00 units acts on the object in the direction of the positive \( y \) axis.

## Question

Find the magnitude the resultant force \( \vec{F}_1 + \vec{F}_2 \).

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( 6.0 \text{ N} \)

- B: B: \( 8.0 \text{ N} \)

- C: C: \( 9.5 \text{ N} \)

- D: D: \( 2.5 \text{ N} \)

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a physics diagram involving forces acting on a wooden crate. There are two hands, each pulling a rope attached to the crate. 

- The left hand pulls upwards on one rope, creating a force labeled \(\vec{F_2}\) with an arrow pointing upwards.
- The right hand pulls another rope to the right at an angle, resulting in a force labeled \(\vec{F_1}\) with an arrow pointing diagonally up and to the right.
- An angle \(\theta\) is shown between the direction of \(\vec{F_1}\) and the horizontal dashed line, indicating the angle of force \(\vec{F_1}\).
- The crate is depicted with diagonal wooden slats for detail.

The image illustrates how these forces and angles interact in the context of physics.
